title: Bledsoe memoir names Taylor as a NASA insider

tellings.quote: >> And outside of her account, super experiencer Chris Bledso's memoir openly names Taylor as a NASA insider who befriended him after his encounters.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a memoir by Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man he calls a "super experiencer" because of the many encounters with unexplained beings he reports, openly names a man called Timothy Taylor as an insider at NASA, the US space agency. According to Michels, Taylor befriended Bledsoe after those encounters in the 2010s. Michels raises it to back up another person's account of Taylor, since if true it would tie a space agency insider to people who report such contact.
